test.create_query: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS timeseries_insert_db ENGINE = Atomic
CREATE TABLE timeseries_insert_db.timeseries_insert UUID '7e5a0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' ENGINE = TimeSeries
CREATE TABLE timeseries_insert_db.timeseries_insert_no_recent UUID '7e5a0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002' ENGINE = TimeSeries SETTINGS recent_samples_ttl_seconds = 0

SELECT throwIf(5 > count() OR countIf(name NOT IN ( '.inner_id.samples.7e5a0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', '.inner_id.recentsamples.7e5a0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', '.inner_id.tags.7e5a0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', '.inner_id.timeranges.7e5a0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', '.inner_id.samples.7e5a0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002', '.inner_id.tags.7e5a0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002', '.inner_id.timeranges.7e5a0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002')) != 0, 'timeseries_insert: an inner table name changed, so merges are not stopped on it') FROM system.tables WHERE database = 'timeseries_insert_db' AND name LIKE '.inner_id.%' AND name NOT LIKE '.inner_id.metric%'
test.query: INSERT INTO timeseries_insert_db.{table} (metric_name, tags, samples) SELECT 'metric_' || toString(number % 10), map('instance', toString(number), 'job', 'job_' || toString(number % 100), 'env', 'prod'), arrayMap(step -> (toDateTime64(toStartOfHour(now()) - 3600 + step * 15, 3), (sipHash64(number, step) % 1000000) / 1000), range(60)) FROM numbers(20000) SETTINGS max_block_size = 2000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 2000
test.drop_query: DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS timeseries_insert_db SYNC
